comparison: Tracked working diff against the fixed baseline plus complete contents of the three new files in scope.
author_independence: Only other authors implementation reviewed; reviewer-owned schema, migration, initializer and four version gates excluded.
standards: AGENTS.md project requirements: DTO centralization, backend authorization/version/source checks, UTC, immutable originals and audit, no unapproved external processing.
CONTRIBUTING.md implementation and validation: reuse existing engines/security/transactions/backup, no network waits inside SQLite write transactions, exact evidence boundaries.
docs/plans/2026-10-17-assistant-storage.md: service authorization, restored-copy write fence, explicit versions, historical backup validation.

checks.result: New request/receipt and read-only intake metadata remain in domain.py. Typed tuples, UUIDs, UTC, target pairs and event consistency reuse existing domain contracts.

Current session/ownership/scope/version and restored-copy write checks are reused at service boundaries; HTTP validates authority before and after bounded body parsing and binds path conversation to request.

Exact request digest replay, profile identity/hash checks, immutable history inserts and intake/link/receipt savepoint share existing transaction API. Sources are read outside the final write transaction; no provider call or original-file mutation added.

After ownership check, metadata derives from the nearest projection receipt and the whole intervening consultation history. Title-only edits keep summary provenance; a consultation replacement breaks it even if later restored. Client export remains a client_reply-only allowlist; internal export distinguishes summary from original words.

Backup validation replays typed canonical requests and exact historical message/material/intake versions, checks owner/workspace/sequence/digests and origin consistency, sanitizes errors and performs no external I/O or writes. It intentionally does not treat later access revocation as historical corruption.
Only the shared validation chain gains validate_profile_records, forwarding the existing allow_assistant policy. No second backup pipeline or relaxed archive validation was introduced.

advisories.observation: Consultation origin rules are maintained across commit, intake read and historical replay. They currently agree; future edits can drift.
advisories.recommendation: Keep their regression cases coordinated when changing provenance semantics; no immediate abstraction or source change required.

smell_review.method: Naming, duplication, cross-module reads, grouped fields, primitive types, repeated branching, scattered edits, multiple change reasons, speculative generalization, call chains, middlemen and inheritance used only as prompts; repository rules take precedence.
smell_review.result: No smell promoted to a hard rule violation; small origin duplication recorded as nonblocking maintenance advice.

excluded: Live models, desktop/installer and real material validation
Other modified frontend/recovery files beyond the named source scope
conclusion: No hard repository-standard violations found in the six stable reviewed sources. Static review is not a runtime or production pass.
